objective: No release is accepted merely because Vercel reports Ready; the exact Git commit and every public trust endpoint must pass production evidence checks.
requiredAssertions: Production commit SHA equals the Git commit under review
All configured NSE, BSE and SEC Tier-0 jobs are attempted
Bounded executor accounting and per-source timing are complete
Every published event has a claim-level evidence chain
No unverified or disputed story enters Must Know
Public-conversation-only and generic stock-tip events remain excluded
Dependability is never claimed before 30 consecutive passing days
